about.label: About
about.heading: Finding the shortest path between business logic and user experience.
about.bio1: Hello, I'm Vida! With years of product design experience, I've led multiple projects across healthcare, esports, fintech, and enterprise communication. I excel at stepping into unfamiliar domains, quickly understanding the business logic, and finding the shortest path to great user experience.
about.bio3: I believe good design isn't about making things pretty — it's about making the right things happen naturally.
about.principle1Desc: Using research and analytics to inform design choices, not relying on intuition alone.
about.principle2Desc: Building scalable Design Systems with reusable components and consistent tokens.
about.principle3Desc: Working closely with PMs, engineers, and stakeholders to ensure designs are fully realized.
about.contactDesc: Currently open for collaboration opportunities. Let's talk about your next product.
